purpose: Direction concepts, not final UI assets

variants.name: A · Lacquer and ink
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: art-direction concept for a real native desktop collectible-card game, Legend of the Five Rings, Emperor Edition. Landscape 16:9. Produce a premium restrained stylized 3D Rokugani war table with a crisp readable 2D game HUD. View nearly top-down, slight 3D depth, table fills the frame. Keep realistic tabletop card density: opponent's four provinces across upper center, player's four provinces across lower center, a few personalities/holdings in each home row, two separate card decks at side, a small five-card player hand along bottom. Upper thin phase timeline, upper left clan identity, bottom right payment/Honor panel, unobtrusive left action log. UI should support playing the game, not marketing. Card art is painterly samurai and Japanese landscapes, no existing card text needs replication. Small clear labels only: "EMPEROR", "ACTION", "BATTLE", "DYNASTY", "CRANE", "LION", "HONOR", "CONFIRM". No large hero text, no photographed people, no neon, no generic dashboard cards, no excessive trim. Direction A: blackened walnut and muted green silk playing surface, copper-gold hairline inlays, ivory paper labels, Japanese black lacquer writing box craftsmanship. Faint five-ring concentric ink motif in the central open battlefield. Two restrained candles at outer corners. Soft warm raking light, cool shadows, rich natural textures. Calm and tactile. Color balance dark earthy frame around quiet desaturated green play area.
